# What is the cheapest way to hit your protein and calories?

> Free cheapest meal plan optimizer. Enter foods with prices and nutrition, set calorie, protein, fat and fibre targets, and get the lowest-cost daily servings plus the cost of each extra target. A minimum-cost diet solver in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
